string-array.name: machine_chest_press_steps
string-array.item: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with the middle of your chest. Plant your feet firmly on the floor.
Keep your chest up and draw your shoulder blades back and down. Avoid overarching your lower back.
Keep your wrists straight and press the handles forward with control. Avoid snapping your elbows into lockout.
Inhale and return slowly to the starting position. Keep your shoulders from rolling forward.

string-array.name: lat_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Secure the thigh pad and grip the bar a little wider than shoulder width.
Lift your chest, lean back slightly, and keep that torso angle.
Drive your elbows down and bring the bar toward your upper chest. Keep the bar in front of your head.
Let the bar rise slowly without swinging your torso. Stop if you feel shoulder pain.

string-array.name: hack_squat_steps
string-array.item: Keep your back and shoulders against the pads. Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Brace your core, release the safety catch, and let your knees track in the same direction as your toes.
Lower with control, keeping your heels on the platform and your lower back against the pad.
Push through your whole foot to rise. Avoid snapping your knees into lockout, then reengage the safety catch.
